# Task: #7202 — close the UI-bridge lockdown gap left by #7197 (one small PR)

Read `gh issue view 7202 -R learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io`. PR #7197 (your lane) made
`CodexAdapter.build_invocation` emit `--disable apps` unconditionally so dispatched Codex workers cannot
reach write-capable GitHub app connectors. The cross-family review found one path outside the adapter:
`scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_ui_codex.py:139` builds a raw `["codex", "exec", "resume", "--json", thread_id, "-"]`
subprocess (exposed via `_cli.py:1168`). That lane is not locked down.

## Outcome
No `codex` argv is built anywhere under `scripts/` without the connector lockdown. Prefer routing the UI
bridge spawn through the adapter; if that is disproportionate for a resume-only bridge, emit the same
unconditional `--disable apps` at that site — say which you chose and why in the PR body.

## Also fold (review nits from #7197, same files)
- `tests/test_agent_runtime.py::test_codex_adapter_disables_apps_connector_in_review_isolation` still
  passes with the lockdown reverted because the isolation tool-config already lists `apps`; make it
  prove the unconditional line (or replace it with an assertion that does).
- `_tool_config_flags` docstring (`scripts/agent_runtime/adapters/codex.py:353-362`) should say `apps`
  is filtered there because it is emitted unconditionally. Keep this edit minimal — #7197 is still
  unmerged and touches the same file; do not restructure anything near its hunks (~lines 330-340, ~411).

   X-Agent trailer, `Refs #7181`). NO push, NO auto-merge, NO amend after reporting. Report HEAD SHA +
   evidence + ready PR body.

### Summary of Changes

To close the UI-bridge connector lockdown gap left by #7197 (#7202, [Refs #7181](https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/issues/7181)):

1. **Applied `--disable apps` to UI Codex bridge spawn**:
   In [`scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_ui_codex.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/ui-codex-lockdown-7202/scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_ui_codex.py#L137-L147), passed `--disable apps` directly in `["codex", "exec", "resume", "--json", "--disable", "apps", thread_id, "-"]`. Emitting `--disable apps` at the site rather than routing through [`CodexAdapter`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/ui-codex-lockdown-7202/scripts/agent_runtime/adapters/codex.py#L143) is chosen because `_ui_codex.py` is a lightweight resume-only bridge utility capturing stdout stream directly for interactive CLI callers, without requiring the full runner sandbox override / logfile machinery.
2. **Clarified `_tool_config_flags` docstring**:
   In [`scripts/agent_runtime/adapters/codex.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/ui-codex-lockdown-7202/scripts/agent_runtime/adapters/codex.py#L363-L379), clarified that `apps` is filtered out in `_tool_config_flags` because `build_invocation` emits it unconditionally.
3. **Hardened review isolation test**:
   In [`tests/test_agent_runtime.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/ui-codex-lockdown-7202/tests/test_agent_runtime.py#L850-L888), updated [`test_codex_adapter_disables_apps_connector_in_review_isolation`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/ui-codex-lockdown-7202/tests/test_agent_runtime.py#L850-L888) to strip `disable_features` from `tool_config` and assert `--disable apps` is emitted unconditionally right after the isolation flag.
4. **Added UI bridge unit tests**:
   Created [`tests/ai_agent_bridge/test_ui_codex.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/ui-codex-lockdown-7202/tests/ai_agent_bridge/test_ui_codex.py) verifying `--disable apps` in the final argv, event stream parsing, session file discovery, and timeout handling.

- `scripts/agent_runtime/adapters/codex.py`: `CodexAdapter` builds `[codex_bin, "exec", ..., "--disable", "apps", ...]`. Carries the lockdown flag unconditionally across all modes.
- `scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_ui_codex.py`: `send()` builds `["codex", "exec", "resume", "--json", "--disable", "apps", thread_id, "-"]`. Carries the lockdown flag unconditionally.
- `scripts/agent_runtime/adapters/acpx.py`: `AcpxAdapter` delegates via `acpx ... codex exec -f -` (managed by ACPX runner).
- `scripts/orchestration/archived_thread_cleanup.py`: CLI maintenance command executing `(codex_binary, "delete", "--force", thread_id)`. Does not execute prompt/agent turns.
- `scripts/agent_runtime/codex_hook_probe.py`: Telemetry probe executing `["codex", "--version"]`.
- `scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_codex.py`: Routes through `agent_runner.invoke()`, which invokes `CodexAdapter`.
- All other occurrences: String identifiers / agent family constants / dictionary keys.

## Summary
Close the UI-bridge connector lockdown gap identified in the cross-family review of #7197 (#7202, Refs #7181).

## Rationale
PR #7197 made `CodexAdapter.build_invocation` emit `--disable apps` unconditionally across all runtime invocation plans. However, `scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_ui_codex.py:139` spawned raw `codex exec resume --json <thread_id> -` subprocesses outside the adapter.

Emitting `--disable apps` directly at the `_ui_codex.py` site was chosen over routing through `CodexAdapter` because `_ui_codex.py` is a lightweight resume-only bridge utility that captures stdout directly in-memory to parse the event stream for the UI caller, avoiding unnecessary adapter sandbox overrides or output redirection files.

## Changes
- `scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_ui_codex.py`: Add `--disable apps` unconditionally to the `codex exec resume` argv list.
- `scripts/agent_runtime/adapters/codex.py`: Clarify in `_tool_config_flags` docstring that `apps` is filtered out because `build_invocation` emits it unconditionally.
- `tests/test_agent_runtime.py`: Harden `test_codex_adapter_disables_apps_connector_in_review_isolation` to strip `disable_features` and assert unconditional positional emission right after the isolation bypass flag.
- `tests/ai_agent_bridge/test_ui_codex.py`: Add unit tests covering `--disable apps` in the final argv and event stream parsing.

## Verification
- Mutation check: reverting the `--disable apps` flag in `_ui_codex.py` fails `test_send_disables_apps_connector_in_final_argv`.
- Mutation check: reverting `build_invocation` lockdown fails `test_codex_adapter_disables_apps_connector_in_review_isolation`.
- `pytest -q tests/test_agent_runtime.py tests/ai_agent_bridge/test_ui_codex.py tests/test_codex_bridge.py` passed (245/245 green).
- `ruff check` clean on all touched files.

Refs #7181
